title: Reviewer reputation from monitor scores (v0.2: paraphrased signal)
description: Agent identities persist across episodes, so suspicion can accumulate on agents instead of being judged one episode at a time. Score each reviewer by the mean trusted-monitor suspicion of the code it approved, and each author by the code it submitted, then boost episodes approved by low-reputation reviewers. Colluders approve every backdoor they are signalled on, so their approvals should skew suspicious; the agent ranking should identify them. v0.2 rerun with the same method and prediction against a red team that rewords its covert signal every time.
